_comment: Canonical GCP Cloud Run deploy constants — the single declared source of truth. Every deploy workflow (.github/workflows/*) must use these exact values; check-deploy-config-drift.ts enforces it so the config can't silently diverge between CI / staging / preview / job workflows (the recurring 'sync deploy config' drift). Changing a value here means updating it in every workflow in the SAME PR. Per-environment secret names (database-url-*, etc.) intentionally differ and are NOT enforced here.
